## Summary

What changes, and why.

## Type

- [ ] feature
- [ ] fix
- [ ] hotfix
- [ ] release
- [ ] docs-ci

## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `develop` (from `main` for a hotfix)
- [ ] PR checks green
- [ ] Review rounds used: _/3. Blocking findings resolved.
- [ ] Nits listed in a comment

## Parity

Pick one (see `docs/parity.md`):

- [ ] same change on both platforms
- [ ] parity follow-up: #... (docs/parity.md updated)
- [ ] platform-only (no user-facing change on the other)

## Release PRs only

- [ ] Beta tag tested on a device: `vX.Y.Z-beta.N`
- [ ] Release notes written above (PRs merged since the last release, open `gap-*` rows of docs/parity.md)
- [ ] User approved "Release X.Y.Z?"
